label: ACCEPT
reason: Every versioned codemod's default export goes through createTransformer: 107 directly (v5/flatten-streamtext-file-properties.ts, v7/move-include-raw-chunks-to-include.ts) and the other 7 via lib factories that themselves return createTransformer (v4/remove-openai-facade.ts, v6/add-await-converttomodelmessages.ts); lib/transform.ts just passes the file to jscodeshift -t, and neither .oxlintrc.json nor tsconfig would reject a bare transformer, which would skip the shared hasChanges/null-return and api.report handling in lib/create-transformer.ts. The five outliers are all lib/ helpers (5 of 114 members, a small and rarely growing directory), so the mixed group is minor and new codemods skipping the wrapper are worth flagging; hesitated with WRONG mixed_group because new lib/ helpers would be false alarms.
